## Description

Briefly describe the purpose of this pull request and the problems it addresses.

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature or capability
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `test`: Added or improved tests
- [ ] `refactor`: Code reorganization with no behavior change
- [ ] `ci`: Workflow or CI/CD adjustments

## Related Issue

Fixes #(issue number)

## Pre-flight Checklist

- [ ] Code follows formatting standards (`cargo fmt --check`)
- [ ] No new compiler or clippy warnings (`cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features`)
- [ ] Added automated tests verifying the changes (`cargo test --workspace`)
- [ ] Ensured non-destructive redactions remain strictly baked into export assets
- [ ] No secrets, keys, or credentials committed
